name: prose-quality
purpose: Keep Mythify user-facing prose concrete without treating subjective style as executable proof.

source.name: pstack unslop
source.adaptation: Selective principles only. Mythify preserves precise domain terms, exact text, and contextual style choices.

forbidden_phrases: It is important to note that

advisory_rules: Delete generic claims that could describe another project unchanged.
Name the actor, action, evidence, measurement, or instruction.
Remove puffery, promotional language, vague attribution, filler, and stacked hedging.
Prefer active voice and split sentences that force the reader to backtrack.
Preserve precise domain terms, exact quotations, logs, commands, legal text, and generated output.
Restore natural rhythm and an appropriate point of view after tightening.
